scope: Read-only diagnosis and next-step proposal. Preserve completed acceptance. No simulator execution, data collection, model forward, feature backbone forward, training, calibration, decoder change or WM execution.
coverage_domains: Actual seed1 training pool 900 core+73 supplementary+36 long windows and C development 300 core+37 supplementary+18 long; extra C held-down/countermotion are separate diagnostic evidence. No other D outcomes used for coverage.

definitions.symbolic_in: Current implemented target is primary categorical location==drawer, after physical held override and support-ownership repair; distinguish XY projection, 3D cavity containment, and task completion. No label changed.
definitions.held_over_open_drawer: Current physical/categorical held, drawer>0.16m, object centre projected into native drawer inner opening footprint. Vertical above/overlap/inside described separately; no assertion that projection implies in.
definitions.pink_held_blue_supported: Current held(pink), not held(blue), blue on table/drawer/slider support category; report all such states, wrist co-visibility, and wrist bounding-box gap.
definitions.close_projection_diagnostic: Both pink and blue >=4 visible wrist pixels and axis-aligned box Euclidean gap <=5 pixels on84px image. Descriptive pre-count bin, never a model threshold or test retuning.
definitions.long_stationary: Same previously frozen64-frame held+TCP/object displacement from first<=1mm; audit actual saved past states, not four repeated images.
definitions.labels_and_masks: Report true physical labels and actual loss/evaluation masks separately, including unscored non-target labels.
definitions.input_checks: Use original public masks and frozen cached feature arrays to check identity, ROI geometry, four-frame offsets and tensor assembly. No new DINO encoding or reader inference.
definitions.saved_C_predictions: Recompute posthoc full-physical-valid object scores only from already saved C prediction arrays; keep original target-only scores unchanged.

geometry: Read native URDF transforms, mesh vertices, recorded drawer joint and block poses; no simulator reconstruction. Visual inner floor plane local y=.025m, side-wall inner x=+-0.225m, interior local z=-.05.. .20m; separately report conservative full collision-mesh upper bound. Validate against each native mesh.
